elements.title: Queen Melisende (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Queen Melisende (pictured) was so incensed by the rumours of her alleged infidelity that neither her husband nor his friends felt safe in her presence?

elements.title: Jewish Ethnographic Expedition (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the questionnaire prepared after the Jewish Ethnographic Expedition had 2,087 questions and was called "a modern epic"?

elements.title: James Alexander Ulio (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that during World War II, US Army casualty telegrams were sent out in the name of Major General James Alexander Ulio?

elements.title: Council of District Dumas (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that to raise funds for the Council of District Dumas, its chairman led an armed squad to storm the Moscow headquarters of the State Bank?

elements.title: Manger on McNichols (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the Boldy James and Sterling Toles collaborative album Manger on McNichols took over a decade to make?

elements.title: Renildo José dos Santos (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Renildo José dos Santos, a Brazilian councilman, was murdered in 1993 after publicly coming out as bisexual?

elements.title: a Kansas City TV station (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a Kansas City TV station was under contract to be sold within a week of its first regular broadcast?

elements.title: Her Story (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Her Story was described as China's answer to Barbie?

elements.title: Jahkeem Stewart (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that football player Jahkeem Stewart was 6 feet 4 inches (1.93 m) and 340 pounds (150 kg) in sixth grade?
